messages.subject: Re: reading VCF file
parts:
Hi Kimani,

One way to do it is:

library(dartR)
obj <- gl.read.vcf("cassava.vcf")
pop_info <- read.table("pop5.txt", header = TRUE)
pop_info <- pop_info[match(obj$ind.names, pop_info$id),]
pop(obj) <- as.factor(pop_info$pop)

Another way to do it is in our tutorial in page 11. We encourage users to first try the resources mentioned at the top of the home page of this google groups forum before posting questions.

Microsoft Word - Tutorial_4_dartR_Data_Manipulation_22-Dec-21 (3).doc (biomatix.org) 

Cheers,
Luis
